acceptanceCriteria: A newer-version context record is never overwritten by an older build: the worker's context is reported UNKNOWN/refused and the file is preserved, with a focused test.
Behavior for a corrupt (not newer) record is specified.
body: Found by lane V1-1549 CI repair (PR beamfall/corvint#1016, head 61eff94be) on 2026-10-17. After raising the alert, the dispatcher replaces a context.json it cannot read, including a newer-version record (ReadContextRecord now refuses it as UNSUPPORTED_VERSION per CAL-V0-131/343). A rollback to an older build therefore destroys newer state instead of refusing; CAL-V0-130 says rollback needs a drain. Recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-17-V1-1549 entry.
title: dispatch overwrites an unreadable context record, including one written by a newer build
